newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends sharply lower at 1,070.50.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends sharply lower at 1,070.50.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended down 10 pesos against the dollar at 1,070.50 on what interbank dealers described as active buying of U.S. currency by banks and local investment funds.
It was the fourth consecutive session in which the peso, which has lost 18.5 pesos against the dollar since last Friday, ended lower.
Wednesday's close was the lowest for the local currency since March 3.
"There was demand (for greenbacks) from private investment funds and a bank that was paying an overseas debt," one trader said when asked to explain the peso's steep drop on the day.
She and others say they were not sure if the trend would continue, however, since any large capital inflows could cause the peso to rebound quickly.
Dealers reported 427 trades for a total of $178 million and said the peso moved in a wide 1,064-to-1,073.00 trading range.
